rationale: The agent verified the user correctly using full name and zip code, and it obtained explicit confirmation before making changes. It successfully initiated the return for the water bottle. However, it failed to complete the full user request because the exchanges for the pet bed and office chair were not completed. The agent proceeded with the return first, then encountered an exchange error and did not provide a supported reason (it speculated about the order status changing to “return requested,” while the tool error cited a “non-delivered order” issue). It also did not attempt an alternative approach or escalation to fulfill the exchange request. Although the agent later provided a savings estimate, the core request (return plus exchanges) was not completed, and part of the explanation was not clearly supported by tool outputs. Therefore, it does not meet the pass bar.
